<!-- pr-reviewer: e81cf16e96a7250c84143383795dba03fd16e3c5 -->
Review at head e81cf16e9. Read, not built: the PR is from a fork, so its code does not run on the maintainer's runners, and no local build slot was free.

The fix is right. `fold_warnings_located` keyed `DrillUndersize` at 216, the same key as the shank `AvoidHit` (`216 + part`, the range 216..=220). A group prints one line, so an undersize hole that came first folded a blocking "Do not touch" hit into "repeated on 1 more move" - the pane hid a crash warning. Key 223 is clear of 216..=220, of 221 (`FirstTraverseLow`), and of 222 (reserved for `UndercutLift`, PR #2836), so the two open PRs do not collide. I checked the whole key table: no two arms share a key except the Gouge pair, which is older and told apart by its second element. The pin folds one undersize warning with one avoid hit for each of the five `FixturePart` values and asserts six lines. `Fixes #3040` is in the body, and the decision file is in the PR. `operations.rs` was past 400 lines on main before this PR; the PR adds 21 lines and is not asked to split it here.

One item owed before readiness: a before/after screenshot of the Warnings pane in the body (the project rule for UI PRs). Before: one line with "repeated"; after: the shank hit on its own line.

Verdict: the code is clean; the screenshot is owed. Labels are not changed by this review.
